messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which positions of the list are the lifting devices located in the municipality of Lula (Sos Enattos mine)?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): words): ["23"]
According to the Igea equipment technical sheet, the Lula (Sos Enattos) gru a cavalletto is at position 23 (Allegato B, table B3). A truck-mounted hydraulic crane is also listed at Lula (Sos Enattos), but its position number is unclear in the source.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 3 | sentence: "Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1" [igea-equipment, p. 3]
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "Euro costruzioni Pellegrini GRU A Lula (Sos Enattos) 23 GCB 35 X 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 Lula CAVALLETTO" [igea-equipment, p. 9]

Answer 2 (given by 1 reader(s): similar): ["3", "23"]
According to the IGEA equipment list, Allegato B, Tabella B3 (p. 9), the lifting devices located in Lula (Sos Enattos) are positions 3 and 23.
Evidence:
- Read on demand: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "Lula Lula (Sos Enattos) F 28A. 22 FIAT RY AUTOCARRO 3 Euro costruzioni Pellegrini GRU A Lula (Sos Enattos) 23 GCB 35 X 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 Lula CAVALLETTO - ex Rimisa 12/21 Classe: matr.459" [igea-equipment, p. 9]

Answer 3 (given by 1 reader(s): search): ["6", "23"]
According to Allegato B, Tabella B3 of the Igea equipment plant record, the lifting devices located in Lula (Sos Enattos) are at list positions 6 and 23; note that the summary in section 2.2 of the same record gives a quantity of 1 for Lula, which does not match the table.
Evidence:
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "6 PER 995 200081/0 2004 6344 Lula Lula (Sos Enattos)" [igea-equipment, p. 9]
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 9 | sentence: "23 GCB 35 X 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 Lula CAVALLETTO - ex Rimisa" [igea-equipment, p. 9]
- Found by search: igea-equipment, p. 3 | sentence: "Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1" [igea-equipment, p. 3]

Readers that found nothing: facts

response.text:
Answer 3 is the best supported. Its evidence shows a table row for position 6 ending in "Lula Lula (Sos Enattos)", and a row for position 23 (the gru a cavalletto) at Lula. Answer 1 leaves out position 6 and admits that the truck-mounted crane's position is unclear. Answer 2's "3" is only a stray number after "AUTOCARRO" in a jumbled line, so it does not show position 3 is at Lula.

Answer 1 omits a second device and admits its position is unclear. Answer 2's '3' is an ambiguous stray number in a jumbled line, not clearly a position at Lula.","choice":3}
